page.title: 最上級の頂上を広げよう

analysis.summaryJa: このページは最上級そのものだけでなく、どの範囲で一番なのか、どれほど大差なのか、順位が何番目なのか、そして過去から現在までの経験全体で最高なのかまで表現を広げる。場所・組織などの範囲にはin、数や明確な候補集合にはofを使い、by far・very・secondはtheを含む語順に注意する。the most ... everは現在完了などと組み合わせ、これまでの経験全体を比較範囲にする。
grammarPoints: 場所・地域・組織などの比較範囲は最上級＋inで示す
数や明確に並んだ候補全体の比較範囲は最上級＋ofで示す
by far the＋最上級で他を大きく引き離す程度を強調する
the very＋最上級ではveryをtheの後ろに置き頂点を強く限定する
the second＋最上級で2番目の順位を表す
the most ... everと現在完了を組み合わせてこれまでの経験全体で最高を表す
visualEvidence: 山頂のランキング峰と範囲リングが、頂点と比較範囲を同時に示している
INとOFの範囲レーンが、場所・集団と数・候補全体の違いを示している
by far the best・the very best・the second bestの修飾レールがtheを含む語順を示している
EVER望遠鏡が、過去から現在までの経験全体を比較対象にすることを表している
commonTraps: 場所や組織の範囲にof、明確な数の集合にinを使う
by farをthe bestの途中に誤って置く
very the bestやsecond the bestのようにtheより前へvery・secondを置く
everを使いながら経験を現在完了で結ばず不自然な時制にする
the most everを数量のmostと混同する

questions.prompt: This is the busiest branch ------- the eastern region.

choices.A: of
choices.B: among of

questions.translationJa: これは東部地域で最も忙しい支店です。
questions.explanationJa: 地域という場所・範囲を示す最上級にはin the eastern regionを使います。

questions.prompt: The blue model is the lightest ------- the four prototypes.

choices.A: of
choices.B: in

questions.translationJa: 青いモデルは4つの試作品の中で最も軽いです。
questions.explanationJa: the four prototypesという明確な4候補の集合にはofを使います。

questions.prompt: The express service is ------- the fastest option for urgent documents.

choices.A: very by far
choices.B: the far by

questions.translationJa: 速達サービスは緊急書類には断然最速の選択肢です。
questions.explanationJa: 最上級を大差で強調する語順はby far the fastestです。空所はtheの前なのでby farが入ります。

questions.prompt: We reserved ------- very largest room for the annual meeting.

choices.A: a
choices.B: the

questions.translationJa: 年次会議のため、まさに最大の部屋を予約しました。
questions.explanationJa: veryで最上級を強く限定する形はthe very largestで、veryはtheの後ろに置きます。

questions.prompt: Lakeview was ranked the ------- best hotel in the customer survey.

choices.A: second
choices.B: two

questions.translationJa: レイクビューは顧客調査で2番目に良いホテルと評価されました。
questions.explanationJa: 順位はthe second bestの語順で表します。

questions.prompt: This is the most useful scheduling tool I have ------- tested.

choices.A: never
choices.B: already

questions.translationJa: これは私がこれまで試した中で最も役立つ日程調整ツールです。
questions.explanationJa: 現在完了have testedとeverを組み合わせ、これまでの経験全体を比較範囲にします。
questions.focus: the most ... I have ever＋過去分詞

questions.prompt: The central office has the highest rent ------- all twelve locations.

choices.A: in
choices.B: of

questions.translationJa: 中央オフィスは12拠点すべての中で最も賃料が高いです。
questions.explanationJa: all twelve locationsという明確な候補集合にはofを使います。

questions.prompt: The new scanner is ------- far the most accurate device in our laboratory.

choices.A: very
choices.B: the

questions.translationJa: 新しいスキャナーは当研究室で断然最も正確な装置です。
questions.explanationJa: by far the most accurateで最上級を大きく強調します。

questions.prompt: The support team received the very ------- score recorded this quarter.

choices.A: highest
choices.B: higher

questions.translationJa: サポートチームは今四半期に記録されたまさに最高の得点を獲得しました。
questions.explanationJa: the very highestの語順で、veryが最高点を強く限定します。

questions.prompt: Of the nine proposals, ours was judged the ------- most practical.

choices.A: twice
choices.B: second

questions.translationJa: 9つの提案のうち、当社案は2番目に実用的と判断されました。
questions.explanationJa: 長い形容詞の順位もthe second most practicalの形で表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence giving a location as the comparison range.

choices.A: This is the oldest station of the city.
choices.B: This is oldest station in the city.
choices.C: This is the older station in the city.
choices.D: This is the oldest station in the city.

questions.translationJa: これは市内で最も古い駅です。
questions.explanationJa: 場所の範囲にはin the cityを使い、通常の最上級にはtheを付けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence comparing six candidates.

choices.A: Ms. Park was the strongest in the six candidates.
choices.B: Ms. Park was the strongest of the six candidates.
choices.C: Ms. Park was strongest of six candidate.
choices.D: Ms. Park was the more strong of the six candidates.

questions.translationJa: パークさんは6人の候補者の中で最も有力でした。
questions.explanationJa: 明確な6人の集合にはof the six candidatesを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence strongly emphasizing a superlative.

choices.A: The revised plan is by far the cheapest option.
choices.B: The revised plan is the by far cheapest option.
choices.C: The revised plan is far by the cheapest option.
choices.D: The revised plan is by the far cheapest option.

questions.translationJa: 改訂案は断然最も安い選択肢です。
questions.explanationJa: 強調表現の正しい語順はby far the cheapestです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence using very with a superlative.

choices.A: We selected very the best location for the booth.
choices.B: We selected the best very location for the booth.
choices.C: We selected the very best location for the booth.
choices.D: We selected the more very best location for the booth.

questions.translationJa: 私たちはブースにまさに最適な場所を選びました。
questions.explanationJa: veryはtheの後ろに置き、the very bestの語順にします。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence expressing second place.

choices.A: This was second the largest order this month.
choices.B: This was the larger second order this month.
choices.C: This was the secondly largest order this month.
choices.D: This was the second largest order this month.

questions.translationJa: これは今月2番目に大きい注文でした。
questions.explanationJa: 順位はthe second largestの語順で表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing an all-time experience.

choices.A: This is the most efficient process I ever tested yesterday.
choices.B: This is the most efficient process I have ever tested.
choices.C: This is the more efficient process I have ever testing.
choices.D: This is most efficient process I have ever test.

questions.translationJa: これは私がこれまで試した中で最も効率的な工程です。
questions.explanationJa: これまでの経験全体を表すにはthe most ... I have ever testedが自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence using a company as the comparison range.

choices.A: Nora has the highest sales of the company.
choices.B: Nora has highest sales in company.
choices.C: Nora has the highest sales in the company.
choices.D: Nora has the higher sales in the company.

questions.translationJa: ノラは社内で最も高い売上を上げています。
questions.explanationJa: companyという組織の範囲にはin the companyを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence comparing a fixed set of models.

choices.A: Model C is the most durable in the five models.
choices.B: Model C is most durable of five models.
choices.C: Model C is the more durable of the five models.
choices.D: Model C is the most durable of the five models.

questions.translationJa: モデルCは5機種の中で最も耐久性があります。
questions.explanationJa: 5機種という固定集合にはof the five modelsを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence emphasizing a large gap from alternatives.

choices.A: The direct flight is the shortest by far route.
choices.B: The direct flight is far the by shortest route.
choices.C: The direct flight is by far the shortest route.
choices.D: The direct flight is by the far shortest route.

questions.translationJa: 直行便は他を大きく引き離して最短の経路です。
questions.explanationJa: by farはthe shortest全体の前に置き、大差を強調します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence ranking a long adjective in second place.

choices.A: It is the second most convenient entrance for visitors.
choices.B: It is most second convenient entrance for visitors.
choices.C: It is the most second convenient entrance for visitors.
choices.D: It is second the most convenient entrance for visitors.

questions.translationJa: それは来訪者にとって2番目に便利な入口です。
questions.explanationJa: 長い形容詞ではthe second most convenientという語順になります。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "This is the largest warehouse in the region."

choices.A: No warehouse in the region is larger than this one.
choices.B: This warehouse is one of several with no size comparison.
choices.C: This warehouse is the largest of four unnamed regions.
choices.D: Every warehouse in the region is larger than this one.

questions.translationJa: この地域で、これより大きい倉庫はありません。
questions.explanationJa: the largest ... in the regionは地域内で最大であることを表します。
questions.focus: in範囲の最上級の言い換え

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Lena was the fastest of the five runners."

choices.A: Lena ran in five different races.
choices.B: All five runners finished at the same time.
choices.C: Four runners were faster than Lena.
choices.D: Lena finished before each of the other four runners.

questions.translationJa: レナは残り4人のどの走者よりも先にゴールしました。
questions.explanationJa: of the fiveで5人全体の中の最速を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The new system is by far the easiest to maintain."

choices.A: The new system is only slightly easier than one alternative.
choices.B: Maintenance is impossible on the new system.
choices.C: The new system is much easier to maintain than all the alternatives.
choices.D: All systems are equally easy to maintain.

questions.translationJa: 新システムは他の選択肢よりはるかに保守しやすいです。
questions.explanationJa: by farは最上級の差が大きいことを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "We chose the very best supplier."

choices.A: We chose a supplier at random.
choices.B: We chose the supplier regarded as the absolute best choice.
choices.D: We chose a supplier better than only one competitor.

questions.translationJa: 私たちはまさに最高と考えられる仕入先を選びました。
questions.explanationJa: the very bestはbestという頂点をさらに強く限定します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "It is the second busiest airport in the country."

choices.A: Only one airport in the country is busier.
choices.B: Exactly two airports are less busy.
choices.C: It is the busiest airport in the country.

questions.translationJa: 国内でこれより混雑する空港は1つだけです。
questions.explanationJa: the second busiestは混雑度が2位であることを意味します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "That is the most helpful advice I have ever received."

choices.A: I received the advice only yesterday, with no comparison.
choices.B: I have never received any advice.
choices.C: No advice I have received at any time has been more helpful.
choices.D: The advice is the second most helpful.

questions.translationJa: これまで受けた助言の中で、それ以上に役立つものはありません。
questions.explanationJa: 現在完了＋everにより、過去から現在までの全経験を比較範囲にしています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "This is the oldest of the seven buildings."

choices.A: The building is old only compared with another district.
choices.B: All seven buildings have the same age.
choices.C: Six buildings are older than this one.
choices.D: This building predates each of the other six buildings.

questions.translationJa: この建物は残り6棟のどれよりも古いです。
questions.explanationJa: of the sevenは7棟の固定集合から最古の一棟を選ぶことを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The premium plan is by far the most flexible."

choices.A: The premium plan is substantially more flexible than all the others.
choices.B: The premium plan has exactly the same flexibility as the others.
choices.C: The premium plan is only the second most flexible.
choices.D: The sentence gives no comparison of flexibility.

questions.translationJa: プレミアムプランは他のすべてより大幅に柔軟です。
questions.explanationJa: by farが最上級の優位差を大きく強調しています。
questions.focus: by far＋最上級の言い換え

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "This is the second most expensive item of the eight."

choices.A: Seven items are more expensive than this one.
choices.B: Only one of the eight items costs more than this one.
choices.C: This is the cheapest of the eight items.
choices.D: The item is not part of the eight-item set.

questions.translationJa: 8品のうち、これより高い品は1つだけです。
questions.explanationJa: the second most expensiveは価格順位が2位であることを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "It was the best service I have ever experienced."

choices.A: I experienced only one service in my life.
choices.B: The service was merely better than yesterday's service.
choices.C: Among all my experiences up to now, none involved better service.
choices.D: I expect the service to become second best.

questions.translationJa: これまでの経験全体で、それ以上のサービスはありませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: have ever experiencedが過去から現在までの経験全体を比較範囲にします。

questions.prompt: Our chain has twenty stores across the prefecture. The Riverside location has the largest showroom ------- the chain.

choices.A: of
choices.B: in

questions.translationJa: 当チェーンは県内に20店舗あります。リバーサイド店はチェーン内で最大のショールームを持ちます。
questions.explanationJa: chainという組織の範囲にはin the chainを使います。

questions.prompt: Four hotels submitted bids for the conference. Harbor Hotel offered the lowest rate ------- the four.

choices.A: in
choices.B: from

questions.translationJa: 会議について4軒のホテルが入札しました。ハーバーホテルが4軒の中で最も安い料金を提示しました。
questions.explanationJa: the fourという明確な候補集合にはofを使います。

questions.prompt: We reviewed six shipping routes. The coastal route is ------- far the safest in winter.

choices.A: by
choices.B: the

questions.translationJa: 6つの輸送経路を検討しました。海岸経路は冬には断然最も安全です。
questions.explanationJa: 大差を示す定型はby far the safestです。

questions.prompt: The audit team found several strong controls. Access logging was the very ------- safeguard in the system.

choices.A: better
choices.B: most good

questions.translationJa: 監査チームはいくつか強固な統制を確認しました。アクセス記録はシステム内でまさに最良の安全策でした。
questions.explanationJa: the very bestの語順で最上級を強く限定します。

questions.prompt: Ten applicants reached the final stage. Ms. Evans received the ------- highest interview score.

choices.A: two
choices.B: secondly

questions.translationJa: 10人が最終選考に進みました。エバンスさんの面接得点は2番目に高いものでした。
questions.explanationJa: 順位2位はthe second highestと表します。

questions.prompt: I have used many expense apps during business trips. This is the easiest one I have ------- used.

choices.A: never
choices.B: ever

questions.translationJa: 出張で多くの経費アプリを使ってきました。これは私がこれまで使った中で最も簡単です。
questions.explanationJa: 現在完了have usedとeverを組み合わせ、経験全体での最上級を作ります。

questions.prompt: The company operates in eight countries. Its Singapore office recorded the fastest growth ------- the organization.

choices.A: in
choices.B: of the eight growth

questions.translationJa: 会社は8か国で事業をしています。シンガポール事務所は組織内で最も速い成長を記録しました。
questions.explanationJa: organizationという組織範囲にはinを用います。

questions.prompt: The three revised layouts are all usable. Layout B is ------- far the most space-efficient.

choices.A: very
choices.B: the

questions.translationJa: 3つの改訂レイアウトはいずれも使えますが、B案が断然最も省スペースです。
questions.explanationJa: by far the most space-efficientで大差の最上級を表します。
questions.focus: by far the most＋複合形容詞

questions.prompt: Seven service plans were compared for the new branch. The annual plan was the ------- most economical overall.

choices.A: two
choices.B: secondly

questions.translationJa: 新支店向けに7つのサービスプランを比較しました。年間プランは総合的に2番目に経済的でした。
questions.explanationJa: 長い形容詞economicalの2位はthe second most economicalです。

questions.prompt: Our director has reviewed hundreds of proposals over her career. She called this the most convincing proposal she has ------- seen.

choices.A: already last week
choices.B: ever

questions.translationJa: 部長はこれまで何百もの提案を審査してきました。彼女はこれを今まで見た中で最も説得力のある提案だと言いました。
questions.explanationJa: has ever seenが長い経験全体を比較範囲にし、the most convincingと結びつきます。
